ddl.name: user_locale_length_check
ddl.value:
"locale" IS NULL
          OR char_length("locale") BETWEEN 2 AND 35

ddl.name: protocol_asset_keys_lengths_check
ddl.value:
char_length("key_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 64
          AND octet_length("ciphertext") BETWEEN 1 AND 4096
          AND char_length("asset_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 255

ddl.name: protocol_events_shape_check
ddl.value:
CASE WHEN "kind" = 'revision'
            THEN "manifest_seq" IS NOT NULL
                 AND "content_hash" IS NOT NULL
                 AND "owner" IS NULL
                 AND "holder" IS NULL
            ELSE "manifest_seq" IS NULL
                 AND "content_hash" IS NULL
                 AND "doc" IS NULL
          END

ddl.name: protocol_write_receipts_created_section_check
ddl.value:
CASE WHEN "operation" = 'create'
            THEN "created_section_id" IS NOT NULL
            ELSE "created_section_id" IS NULL
          END

ddl.name: assets_uploaded_by_user_id_check
ddl.value:
"uploaded_by_user_id" IS NULL
          OR char_length("uploaded_by_user_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 255

ddl.name: study_waves_window_check
ddl.value:
"opens_at" IS NULL
          OR "closes_at" IS NULL
          OR "closes_at" > "opens_at"

ddl.name: participants_email_check
ddl.value:
"email" IS NULL
          OR (char_length("email") BETWEEN 3 AND 320
              AND "email" = lower(btrim("email")))

ddl.name: interview_sessions_terminal_state_check
ddl.value:
("status" = 'completed') = ("completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("status" = 'abandoned') = ("abandoned_at" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: interview_sessions_finish_check
ddl.value:
("finish_stage_id" IS NULL) = ("finish_outcome" IS NULL)
          AND ("finish_stage_id" IS NULL OR (
            "status" = 'completed'
            AND char_length("finish_stage_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 128
            AND "finish_outcome" IN ('completed', 'ineligible', 'terminated')))

ddl.name: interview_sessions_stage_check
ddl.value:
"current_stage_index" >= 0
          AND ("current_stage_id" IS NULL
               OR char_length("current_stage_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 128)

ddl.name: interview_sessions_holder_check
ddl.value:
"holder_epoch" >= 0
          AND ("holder_id" IS NULL OR char_length("holder_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 128)

ddl.name: interview_sessions_ego_check
ddl.value:
char_length("ego_uid") BETWEEN 1 AND 128
          AND jsonb_typeof("ego_attributes") = 'object'
          AND jsonb_typeof("stage_metadata") = 'object'
          AND ("ego_secure_attributes" IS NULL
               OR jsonb_typeof("ego_secure_attributes") = 'object')

ddl.name: session_snapshots_payload_check
ddl.value:
jsonb_typeof("payload") = 'object'
          AND "schema_version" > 0
          AND char_length("payload_hash") BETWEEN 1 AND 128

ddl.name: nodes_identifier_lengths_check
ddl.value:
char_length("node_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 128
          AND char_length("type") BETWEEN 1 AND 128
          AND ("stage_id" IS NULL
               OR char_length("stage_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 128)

ddl.name: nodes_attributes_object_check
ddl.value:
jsonb_typeof("attributes") = 'object'
          AND ("secure_attributes" IS NULL
               OR jsonb_typeof("secure_attributes") = 'object')

ddl.name: edges_identifier_lengths_check
ddl.value:
char_length("edge_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 128
          AND char_length("type") BETWEEN 1 AND 128
          AND char_length("from_node") BETWEEN 1 AND 128
          AND char_length("to_node") BETWEEN 1 AND 128

ddl.name: edges_attributes_object_check
ddl.value:
jsonb_typeof("attributes") = 'object'
          AND ("secure_attributes" IS NULL
               OR jsonb_typeof("secure_attributes") = 'object')

ddl.name: study_role_grants_identifier_lengths_check
ddl.value:
char_length("user_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 255
          AND char_length("granted_by_user_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 255

ddl.name: consent_documents_state_evidence_check
ddl.value:
("state" = 'draft') = ("published_at" IS NULL)
          AND ("state" = 'retired') = ("retired_at" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: consent_documents_lengths_check
ddl.value:
char_length("title") BETWEEN 1 AND 320
          AND "title" ~ '[^[:space:]]'
          AND char_length("locale") BETWEEN 2 AND 35

ddl.name: participant_consents_withdrawal_check
ddl.value:
("withdrawn_at" IS NULL) = ("withdrawn_by" IS NULL)
          AND ("withdrawn_at" IS NULL OR "withdrawn_at" >= "granted_at")
          AND ("withdrawal_note" IS NULL OR "withdrawn_at" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: participant_consents_withdrawal_note_check
ddl.value:
"withdrawal_note" IS NULL
          OR char_length("withdrawal_note") BETWEEN 1 AND 1000

ddl.name: study_schedules_anchor_check
ddl.value:
"anchor_kind" IN ('enrolment', 'wave_window_start', 'fixed_date')
          AND ("anchor_kind" = 'fixed_date') = ("anchor_date" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("anchor_kind" <> 'wave_window_start' OR "wave_id" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: study_schedules_recurrence_check
ddl.value:
"recurrence_kind" IN ('one_off', 'fixed_interval', 'random_sample')
          AND ("recurrence_kind" = 'fixed_interval') = ("interval_days" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("recurrence_kind" = 'random_sample') = ("samples_per_period" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("samples_per_period" IS NULL) = ("period_days" IS NULL)
          AND ("samples_per_period" IS NULL) = ("min_gap_minutes" IS NULL)
          AND ("recurrence_kind" <> 'one_off' OR "occurrence_limit" IS NULL)

ddl.name: study_schedules_recurrence_bounds_check
ddl.value:
("interval_days" IS NULL OR "interval_days" BETWEEN 1 AND 365)
          AND ("samples_per_period" IS NULL OR "samples_per_period" BETWEEN 1 AND 24)
          AND ("period_days" IS NULL OR "period_days" BETWEEN 1 AND 365)
          AND ("min_gap_minutes" IS NULL OR "min_gap_minutes" BETWEEN 0 AND 43200)
          AND ("occurrence_limit" IS NULL OR "occurrence_limit" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000)
          AND "anchor_offset_minutes" BETWEEN -43200 AND 43200

ddl.name: study_schedules_window_check
ddl.value:
"window_start_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439
          AND "window_end_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439
          AND "window_start_minute" < "window_end_minute"
          AND "days_of_week_mask" BETWEEN 1 AND 127

ddl.name: study_schedules_quiet_hours_check
ddl.value:
("quiet_hours_start_minute" IS NULL) = ("quiet_hours_end_minute" IS NULL)
          AND ("quiet_hours_start_minute" IS NULL
               OR ("quiet_hours_start_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439
                   AND "quiet_hours_end_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439))

ddl.name: study_schedules_channels_check
ddl.value:
coalesce(array_length("channels", 1), 0) BETWEEN 1 AND 2
          AND "channels" <@ ARRAY['email', 'sms']::text[]
          AND (array_length("channels", 1) = 1
               OR "channels"[1] <> "channels"[2])

ddl.name: schedule_occurrences_bounds_check
ddl.value:
"occurrence_index" >= 1
          AND "scheduled_local_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439
          AND "expires_at" > "scheduled_for"
          AND char_length("resolved_time_zone") BETWEEN 1 AND 64

ddl.name: message_templates_subject_check
ddl.value:
("channel" = 'email') = ("subject" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("subject" IS NULL OR char_length("subject") BETWEEN 1 AND 200)

ddl.name: message_deliveries_lengths_check
ddl.value:
char_length("recipient_address") BETWEEN 3 AND 320
          AND ("last_error" IS NULL OR char_length("last_error") <= 1000)
          AND ("provider_message_id" IS NULL
               OR char_length("provider_message_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 255)

ddl.name: api_tokens_actor_lengths_check
ddl.value:
char_length("created_by_user_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 255
          AND char_length("custodian_user_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 255
          AND ("revoked_by_user_id" IS NULL OR char_length("revoked_by_user_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 255)

ddl.name: templates_lengths_check
ddl.value:
char_length("name") BETWEEN 1 AND 200
          AND "name" ~ '[^[:space:]]'
          AND ("summary" IS NULL OR char_length("summary") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000)
          AND ("author_user_id" IS NULL OR char_length("author_user_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 255)

ddl.name: webhook_subscriptions_event_types_check
ddl.value: COALESCE(array_length("event_types", 1), 0) BETWEEN 1 AND 50 AND array_position("event_types", NULL) IS NULL

ddl.name: webhook_subscriptions_lengths_check
ddl.value:
char_length("secret_key_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 64
          AND octet_length("secret_ciphertext") BETWEEN 1 AND 512
          AND char_length("created_by_user_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 255
          AND ("description" IS NULL OR char_length("description") BETWEEN 1 AND 500)

ddl.name: webhook_deliveries_lengths_check
ddl.value:
char_length("webhook_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 128
          AND char_length("event_type") BETWEEN 1 AND 128
          AND "attempt_count" >= 0
          AND ("last_status_code" IS NULL OR "last_status_code" BETWEEN 100 AND 599)
          AND ("last_error" IS NULL OR char_length("last_error") <= 1000)

ddl.name: experiments_state_check
ddl.value:
"state" IN ('draft', 'running', 'stopped')
          AND ("state" = 'draft') = ("started_at" IS NULL)
          AND ("state" = 'stopped') = ("stopped_at" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("stopped_at" IS NULL OR "stopped_at" >= "started_at")

ddl.name: feedback_reports_lengths_check
ddl.value:
char_length("body") BETWEEN 1 AND 5000
          AND "body" ~ '[^[:space:]]'
          AND ("external_ref" IS NULL OR char_length("external_ref") BETWEEN 1 AND 500)
          AND ("reporter_user_id" IS NULL OR char_length("reporter_user_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 255)

ddl.name: study_wave_rollups_counts_check
ddl.value:
"invited_count" >= 0 AND "onboarding_started_count" >= 0
          AND "consented_count" >= 0 AND "session_started_count" >= 0
          AND "session_completed_count" >= 0 AND "session_abandoned_count" >= 0
          AND "delivery_failed_count" >= 0

ddl.name: study_stage_rollups_counts_check
ddl.value:
"entered_count" >= 0 AND "completed_count" >= 0
          AND "abandoned_count" >= 0 AND "duration_ms_sum" >= 0
          AND "duration_ms_count" >= 0 AND "missing_item_count" >= 0
          AND char_length("stage_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 128

ddl.name: audit_events_identifier_lengths_check
ddl.value:
char_length("team_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 255
          AND char_length("event_type") BETWEEN 1 AND 128
          AND ("actor_id" IS NULL OR char_length("actor_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 255)
          AND ("subject_type" IS NULL OR char_length("subject_type") BETWEEN 1 AND 64)
          AND ("subject_id" IS NULL OR char_length("subject_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 255)
          AND ("resource_type" IS NULL OR char_length("resource_type") BETWEEN 1 AND 64)
          AND ("resource_id" IS NULL OR char_length("resource_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 255)

ddl.name: audit_events_label_lengths_check
ddl.value:
char_length("team_label") BETWEEN 1 AND 320
          AND char_length("actor_label") BETWEEN 1 AND 320
          AND ("subject_label" IS NULL OR char_length("subject_label") BETWEEN 1 AND 320)
          AND ("resource_label" IS NULL OR char_length("resource_label") BETWEEN 1 AND 320)

ddl.name: audit_export_jobs_budgets_check
ddl.value:
"row_limit" > 0 AND "byte_limit" > 0
          AND "preflight_row_count" >= 0 AND "preflight_byte_count" >= 0
          AND "attempt_count" >= 0
          AND "start_event_sequence" > 0
          AND "high_water_sequence" >= 0

ddl.name: audit_export_jobs_ready_state_check
ddl.value:
("status" = 'ready') = (
            "handle_hash" IS NOT NULL
            AND "handle_expires_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "artifact_key" IS NOT NULL
            AND "artifact_row_count" IS NOT NULL
            AND "artifact_byte_count" IS NOT NULL
            AND "completion_event_id" IS NOT NULL
            AND "ready_at" IS NOT NULL
          )

ddl.name: audit_export_jobs_failed_state_check
ddl.value:
("status" = 'failed') = (
            "failed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "failure_event_id" IS NOT NULL
          )
          AND ("status" <> 'failed' OR "artifact_key" IS NULL)

ddl.name: audit_export_jobs_consumed_check
ddl.value: "handle_consumed_at" IS NULL OR "handle_hash" IS NOT NULL

ddl.name: audit_export_jobs_identifier_lengths_check
ddl.value:
char_length("team_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 255
          AND char_length("actor_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 255
          AND ("artifact_key" IS NULL OR char_length("artifact_key") BETWEEN 1 AND 1024)
          AND ("last_error" IS NULL OR char_length("last_error") <= 1000)

ddl.name: audit_alert_outbox_lengths_check
ddl.value:
char_length("team_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 255
          AND char_length("event_type") BETWEEN 1 AND 128
          AND char_length("alert_policy_key") BETWEEN 1 AND 128
          AND ("last_error" IS NULL OR char_length("last_error") <= 1000)

ddl.name: team_invitation_deliveries_payload_lengths_check
ddl.value:
char_length("team_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 255
          AND char_length("email") BETWEEN 1 AND 320
          AND char_length("team_label") BETWEEN 1 AND 320
          AND char_length("inviter_label") BETWEEN 1 AND 320

ddl.name: installation_bootstrap_token_check
ddl.value:
("bootstrap_token_hash" IS NULL) = ("bootstrap_token_issued_at" IS NULL)
          AND ("bootstrap_token_hash" IS NULL OR "bootstrap_token_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

ddl.name: installation_name_check
ddl.value:
"name" IS NULL
          OR (char_length("name") BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND "name" ~ '[^[:space:]]')

ddl.name: deployment_state_reason_check
ddl.value:
("maintenance" = false AND "reason" IS NULL)
          OR ("maintenance" = true
              AND ("reason" IS NULL
                   OR (char_length("reason") BETWEEN 1 AND 280
                       AND "reason" ~ '[^[:space:]]')))

ddl.name: deployment_state_latest_release_check
ddl.value:
("latest_version" IS NULL) = ("latest_released_at" IS NULL)
          AND ("latest_version" IS NULL) = ("latest_notes_url" IS NULL)
          AND ("latest_version" IS NULL) = ("latest_schema_change" IS NULL)
          AND ("latest_version" IS NULL
               OR "latest_version" ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)[.](0|[1-9][0-9]*)[.](0|[1-9][0-9]*)$')
          AND ("latest_notes_url" IS NULL OR "latest_notes_url" ~ '^https://')
